profile_text.body:
Sinovation Ventures is a Chinese technology venture capital firm. Its website states it was founded in 2009 by a team led by Dr. Kai-Fu Lee. The company describes itself as a leading Chinese technology venture capital firm, managing ten USD- and RMB-denominated funds with over US$3 billion in assets under management and backing more than 500 portfolio companies across technology and innovation globally.

The firm is a for-profit investor headquartered in Beijing, China, and was founded in 2009. No lawsuits, SEC filings, or patent facts are associated with Sinovation Ventures in the available data.
